title: Cortisol Belly Is Real, But TikTok Has It Wrong
hook: Cortisol belly is real, but the TikTok fixes for it, like the cortisol cocktail, won't take an inch off your waist.
body: Stress and high cortisol are linked to belly fat. But cortisol doesn't make belly fat out of nothing: stress makes you eat more, and the extra calories land on your belly. The cortisol cocktail is orange juice and coconut water with some salt, about 80 calories and most of that is sugar, so skip it and skip the adrenal supplements too.
